title: DirectRequest
description: Structured inter-agent control signal (ADR-003, §2.5). The only sanctioned form of addressing another agent. `additionalProperties` is false: no side-channel field of any name can carry a routed signal. A turn's `structured_output.direct_requests` is a (possibly empty) array of these objects (§4.5 multiplicity).

target.description: Agent id of the addressee. Runtime target-validation policy lives in §4.5.

type.description: Request category. OPEN string at the schema level; recommended values per §4.5.

content.description: Request payload: a free-text question or a structured object.
